Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.securitycenter

Class AntivirusBackend.ScanOutputParser

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.securitycenter.AntivirusBackend.ScanOutputParser
Enclosing class:
AntivirusBackend
public static final class AntivirusBackend.ScanOutputParser extends Object
An incremental, one-line-at-a-time ClamAV output parser: the streaming twin of AntivirusBackend.parseScanOutput(java.util.List<java.lang.String>, int). SecurityCenterPanel feeds it each line as the scanner prints it, so it can drive a live progress bar (files seen, threats so far, the current file) without buffering the whole run, then calls toReport(int) once the process exits to get exactly the ScanReport the batch parser would have produced from the same lines.
